create_kitti_info_file: create KITTI dataset info pkl files for train, val, and test splits from raw data
create_waymo_info_file: create Waymo dataset info pkl files for train, val, and test splits with max sweeps
create_reduced_point_cloud: create reduced point clouds for KITTI train, val, and test sets by removing out-of-view points
convert_to_kitti_info_version2: convert KITTI info dict from v1 flat key format to v2 nested image, calib, and point_cloud structure
calculate_num_points_in_gt: calculate the number of LiDAR points inside each ground truth 3D bounding box for KITTI annotations
